text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Incredible, Taishiiin!!
That was a great run, Taishiiin!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"I totally fell for your sharpness!!
Show me a win next time, alright?!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But I can't be satisfied
with just this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: If you get it, then let's get going already.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Heading into the Japan Derby,
I'm gonna retrain myself from scratch...!!

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
That was incredible... so incredible...!!
I... I want to, too...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, w-what's wrong, are you okay!?
Are you... crying...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she couldn't claim victory,
Narita Taishin's fierce running seemed to leave
a lasting impression on many hearts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the Satsuki Sho drew to a close—
Now, the days leading up to the
Japanese Derby were about to begin...!
